task_title: Floor 4 Green Room intermission transaction and shops

plan_review.notes: Adversarial review approved with changes. Alt A: a physical-room transaction coordinated by the existing arenaDirectorSystem plus a dedicated Floor 4 Green Room helper — chosen because it preserves single phase authority while isolating stock/interaction/seal state. Alt B: a menu overlay — rejected because FR5.1 requires a physical room; transactional relocation/scrub gives equivalent safety. Alt C: shared world RNG or wholesale Floor 2 settlement reuse — rejected because stock would be path-dependent and Floor-2-only state/IDs are incompatible. Resolutions: define stable table-backed vendor IDs and positions, explicit Floor 4 exit/stairs presentation/action contract, generic run-scoped stock lifecycle rather than directly calling Floor 2 helpers, player-driven intermission (no timed/prearmed transition), scrub all hostile/projectile/effect/debt state before relocation, sale semantics including equipped/generated disposal, headless interaction route, affordability and divergent-combat tests, and completion-copy update. divergence=minor: helper/contract boundaries were added; ADR 0090 architecture remains sound.
